name: Demo AI Partner Module
description: Reference marketplace manifest demonstrating the full Vssyl AI contract (Phase 4D)
readme:
# Demo AI Partner Module

Canonical **full AI contract** sample for marketplace developers and certification dry-runs.

## Includes

- Complete `aiContext` (keywords, patterns, entities, actions, relationships, context providers)
- Webhook `aiActionExecutor` with HMAC `signingSecret`
- Notification metadata
- Personal + business supported contexts

## Docs

- `docs/guides/MODULE_AI_SDK_BOUNDARIES.md`
- `docs/guides/AI_CONTEXT_PROVIDER_API.md`
- `docs/architecture/WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTIONS.md`

## Certification

Run: `pnpm --filter vssyl-server exec vitest run src/services/__tests__/fullAiContractModule.certification.test.ts`
